CREATE MASTER KEY
ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'Password';

-----------------------------
--DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIALS
------------------------------
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL aditi_creds
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

-----------------------------
--EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
-----------------------------

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver_source
WITH
(
   LOCATION ='https://azuresynapseaditi.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/',
   CREDENTIAL=aditi_creds
)
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE gold
WITH
(
   LOCATION ='https://azuresynapseaditi.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/',
   CREDENTIAL=aditi_creds
)

--------------------------------------
---EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT
--------------------------------------
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH
(
   FORMAT_TYPE=PARQUET,
   DATA_COMPRESSION='org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'

)
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT delta
WITH
(
   FORMAT_TYPE=DELTA,
   )
